title: XML External Entity Static Analysis Rules

rules.name: Standard library XML parser used on external input
rules.description: xml.etree.ElementTree.parse/fromstring, xml.dom.minidom.parse/parseString or xml.sax.parse reads XML with the standard library defaults, which expand external entities. A document that declares a SYSTEM entity can read local files or make the parser issue outbound requests, so untrusted XML must be parsed with defusedxml instead.
rules.remediation_example: from defusedxml import ElementTree as SafeET; tree = SafeET.parse(source)

rules.name: XML parser explicitly enables entity resolution
rules.description: lxml.etree.XMLParser is constructed with resolve_entities=True or no_network=False. Those settings re-enable the external entity and network behaviour that lxml disables by default, so a crafted document can read local files or reach remote hosts.
